issues.title: Minecraft 1.17 to 1.20.4 did not start in LOAM 1.5.x
Uninstaller option "Delete the application data" removes games for installs upgraded from before 1.5.1
issues.workaround: Leave the box unticked when uninstalling (default), or back up the games folder in %LOCALAPPDATA%\app.loam.launcher first.

issues.title: Windows SmartScreen warns about the installer
issues.workaround: Check the SHA-256 in SHA256SUMS.txt, then choose More info, Run anyway. Code signing is planned.

issues.title: For missing or conflicting mods, Fabric's own error window appears before LOAM's crash card
issues.workaround: Close Fabric's window; LOAM then shows the explanation and the one-click fix.

issues.title: Forge and NeoForge games are not supported
issues.workaround: Use the Migration Hub's Import worlds to bring a Forge or NeoForge instance's worlds and packs into a vanilla game.
